gen.title: Practice recalling drag influences and equation form

cards.stem: Which expression shows how drag is calculated from coefficient, density, velocity and area
cards.hint: Recall the form that uses half the velocity squared

cards.stem: Which factor is listed as influencing drag along with velocity and shape
cards.quote: Drag depends on the density of the air, the square of the velocity
cards.hint: Think about properties of the surrounding fluid

cards.stem: What single variable is used to collect complex dependencies for drag
cards.quote: For drag, this variable is called the drag coefficient, designated “Cd.”
cards.hint: It is designated by two letters starting with C

cards.stem: How is the area term in the drag equation described
cards.quote: Notice that the area (A) given in the drag equation is given as a reference area.
cards.hint: It indicates the chosen area for comparing coefficients
